prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you have my claim file, so you can use that.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pearland, Texas. I was in the left lane and wanted to move over to the right lane because my exit was coming up.
Q: What did you do before you changed lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. The right lane looked clear to me at that moment.
Q: Then what happened?
A: As I started to move over, the other vehicle came up alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car pull toward the right.
Q: Did you stop after the contact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder as soon as I could and turned on my hazard lights.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: I'd say I was going around the posted speed limit, maybe a little under it because traffic was slowing.
Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?
A: Not right away. Over the next day my neck started to ache and it's stiff when I turn my head. I was diagnosed with a neck strain and I'm still doing physical therapy.
Q: Did you seek medical care that same day?
A: I went to urgent care the following morning because the pain got worse overnight.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your account?
A: Only that I'm willing to cooperate fully and I'll send any records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
